Volume ratio at 0.65 indicates subdued activity. The 52-week position at 18.2% remains low, but the lack of clear direction warrants a wait-and-see approach.

· 52주 위치(18.2%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 구간
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (42.5→39.7) + 중립 구간 횡보 판단 + 하락 방향성 해석
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (히스토 -0.0113→-0.0038) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 미약
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $1.35) + 밴드폭 15.78%로 중간 수준 해석
[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.65배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 명확한 지표 정렬 시 매수 진입 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($1.30) vs SMA5/20/50($1.31/$1.35/$1.36): Below short/mid-term, above long-term trends.
· SMA100/200($1.29/$1.28) comparison: Weak long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (18.2%) + Current price range historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (42.5→39.7) + Neutral range consolidation assessment + Downward momentum interpretation.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (histo -0.0113→-0.0038) + Improvement diagnosis + Weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $1.35) + Bandwidth at 15.78% interpreted as moderate.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1.28) + Based on SMA100/200.
· Swing Resistance ($1.39) + Potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) + Interpretation of lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.65x) + Decreased reliability of price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation) + Buy entry condition upon clear indicator alignment.
